intro: Great sleep isn’t a luxury—it’s essential. Sleep Essential is designed to adapt to you. It offers personalised support and cool comfort. So, no matter how your day goes, your nights stay restful.

features.title: Support that adjusts to you
features.text: Hybrid materials and pressure-neutralizing segments adapt to body weight, ensuring personalised support and undisturbed sleep for light, medium, and heavy body frames.

features.title: Just the right firmness for deep rest
features.text: Combines soft cushioning and firm support to provide the perfect sleeping surface, reducing pressure points and enhancing overall comfort throughout the night.

features.title: Stay cool, sleep better
features.text: High-quality fabric ensures optimal airflow, preventing overheating and promoting a refreshing sleep environment for a comfortable and cool experience.

features.title: Effortless care, lasting freshness
features.text: The removable fabric cover allows effortless cleaning, ensuring long-lasting hygiene and freshness with minimal maintenance.

features.title: Designed to suit various body weights
features.text: With hybrid materials and pressure-neutralizing segments, this mattress adapts to your body weight, offering balanced support and an undisturbed sleep experience.

name: Sleep Essential Double Bed Spring Mattress 75 X 48 X 5 Inches
